scope: read-only diagnosis of bdc17cdf async repaint stall; no UI control, source change, environment change, or third-party setting change

observed_facts.fact: Async root websocket events call update followed by cx.refresh().
Async screen State/Frame events update Computer and call cx.refresh() after a successful update.
The native input diagnostic recorded AX access and visible=true/AXMinimized=false, while coordinate clicks returned noWindowsAvailable; a later keyboard/pointer interaction produced visible content.

The environment audit recorded Mac Bot onscreen=true, alpha=1, AX focused=true, frontmost=false, plus two BetterDisplay fullscreen alpha=1 windows at a higher layer; the audit did not read in-process NSWindow.occlusionState.
A three-second sample placed the main thread in NSApplication nextEventMatchingMask/CoreFoundation run loop at about 0.5% CPU, with no observed Rust event-bridge starvation.

framework_facts.fact: AsyncApp::refresh queues App::refresh_windows; it does not directly draw.
The GPUI platform trait defaults frame_waker() to None and schedule_frame() to a no-op.
The macOS GPUI start_display_link path returns when NSWindowOcclusionStateVisible is absent.

inference_status.environment_candidate: AppKit occlusion/display-link suspension caused by a higher-layer BetterDisplay window remains plausible; AX/CGWindow visible state is insufficient to prove or disprove it.
inference_status.interpretation: A key event immediately making async content visible is consistent with a parked native frame source, but does not by itself prove occlusion.

A: User makes Mac Bot genuinely frontmost.
User temporarily hides or exits BetterDisplay coverage only for the test; do not modify its settings.
With MACBOT_DIAGNOSTICS=1, trigger one async screen/RPC update and capture timing without pressing a key.
Record whether frame/state applied and screenshot update occur within the normal update interval.
B: Restore the prior BetterDisplay coverage state without changing configuration.
Repeat the identical async update and capture timing without pressing a key.
required_ab_verification.decision_rule: Only an A pass and B stall with otherwise identical app/server state supports an occlusion/display-link attribution. If both stall, continue platform/runtime diagnosis; if both pass, retain the issue as un-reproduced.

boundary: Do not claim S4 desktop continuous repaint is closed until the A/B native observation is completed.
